(assert (! (or (> 1000000 0) (< 1000000 0)) :named denom_nonzero))

(assert (! (<= (- computed_income_before_income_taxes 26015.0) 260.15) :named claim_upper))
(assert (! (<= (- 26015.0 computed_income_before_income_taxes) 260.15) :named claim_lower))

(get-unsat-core)
(get-model)

smtlib:
(set-logic QF_NRA)
(set-option :produce-unsat-cores true)
(set-option :produce-models true)

(declare-const computed_liabilities_current_fy2024 Real)
(declare-const accounts_payable_current_fy2024 Real)
(declare-const accrued_income_taxes_current_fy2024 Real)
(declare-const accrued_liabilities_current_fy2024 Real)
(declare-const long_term_debt_current_fy2024 Real)
(declare-const operating_lease_liability_current_fy2024 Real)
(declare-const short_term_borrowings_fy2024 Real)

(assert (! (= accounts_payable_current_fy2024 2851.0) :named evidence_accounts_payable_current_fy2024))
(assert (! (= accrued_income_taxes_current_fy2024 534.0) :named evidence_accrued_income_taxes_current_fy2024))
(assert (! (= accrued_liabilities_current_fy2024 5725.0) :named evidence_accrued_liabilities_current_fy2024))
(assert (! (= long_term_debt_current_fy2024 1000.0) :named evidence_long_term_debt_current_fy2024))
(assert (! (= operating_lease_liability_current_fy2024 477.0) :named evidence_operating_lease_liability_current_fy2024))
(assert (! (= short_term_borrowings_fy2024 6.0) :named evidence_short_term_borrowings_fy2024))

(assert (! (= computed_liabilities_current_fy2024 (+ (+ long_term_debt_current_fy2024 short_term_borrowings_fy2024) (+ accounts_payable_current_fy2024 accrued_liabilities_current_fy2024) (+ accrued_income_taxes_current_fy2024 operating_lease_liability_current_fy2024))) :named formula_liabilities_current_fy2024))

(assert (! (or (> short_term_borrowings_fy2024 0) (< short_term_borrowings_fy2024 0)) :named denom_nonzero))
(assert (! (or (> accounts_payable_current_fy2024 0) (< accounts_payable_current_fy2024 0)) :named denom_nonzero1))
(assert (! (or (> accrued_income_taxes_current_fy2024 0) (< accrued_income_taxes_current_fy2024 0)) :named denom_nonzero2))
